rawContext.note: Context values are approximate visual readings. The center-line event itself is preserved as the explicit 11-count RAW bracket.

observation.description: The visible solar limb moves across a fixed detector reference while the direct Epoch-5 physical counter advances.
observation.detectorArtifact: A detector-fixed dirt or polarizer mark remains fixed relative to the camera field and is excluded from celestial interpretation.

boundaries.note: This record preserves a visible geometric event bracketed by physical Epoch-5 RAW. It does not invent an instantaneous exposure pulse or a prediction residual.
